opentofu-and-the-terraform-ecosystem-cho.r: After switching tools, the first plan showed a destroy and create of a production database. The provider version was not pinned, so the new tool installed a newer provider that changed a default.
opentofu-and-the-terraform-ecosystem-cho.x: The tools share syntax, so the decision is about licence, support and migration cost, tested on a small project first.

pulumi-infrastructure-in-real-programmin.r: A script printed a bucket name that never worked in a connection string. The program built the URL by joining plain strings with the output object, which produced an unresolved placeholder in the application.
pulumi-infrastructure-in-real-programmin.x: A general purpose language gives loops, functions and tests, at the cost of more freedom to write unreadable code.

terragrunt-modules-and-multi-environment.r: A change to a tag in a shared network stack planned changes for 400 resources. All environments pointed to the unversioned main branch of the module, so a one line change affected every stack at once.
terragrunt-modules-and-multi-environment.x: Keep shared code in versioned modules and only inputs per environment, so a fix in one place reaches all environments safely.

testing-infrastructure-code.r: An integration test failed midway and left a database and a load balancer running. The test destroyed resources only on success. Cleanup now runs in a final step that always executes, tests tag everything with an owner and expiry, and a nightly job deletes anything past its expiry in the test account.
testing-infrastructure-code.x: Test at several levels, from static checks to disposable real deployments, and keep the fast ones in every pull request.

policy-as-code-and-drift-detection.r: During an incident someone opened a port to the internet and never closed it. The nightly drift plan reported the change and a ticket was opened automatically.
policy-as-code-and-drift-detection.x: Check policy before apply and watch for drift afterwards, so both new changes and manual edits are visible.

state-secrets-and-safe-migrations.r: A refactor into modules changed resource addresses and the plan showed a destroy. The code moved the resource into a module without a moved block. The team added a moved block from the old to the new address, the next plan showed only a move, and prevent_destroy was added to the database as a guard.
state-secrets-and-safe-migrations.x: Treat state as critical and sensitive, back it up, and use declarative moves so a refactor never destroys real resources.
